titulo: Turn off the light in the empty room
caption:
Turn off the light in the empty room

One lamp on, nobody in the room. Cella walks in and switches it off.

alt: A short film with no voice, with music. A lavender room with an empty chair in the middle and a lit lamp on the right. A small ink-black block figure with white eyes walks in from the left and its eyes go wide. A bubble that says empty room appears and goes away. The figure leans toward the lamp and the lamp goes off. Its eyes close in a smile and it pulses. The text stays: 1 light on, 0 people in the room.
